Finish the current complete game after the rally target. Carry the training-only critic between iterations. Update only from candidate player trajectories.
checks: Reject invalid provenance, unsafe candidate or saved-opponent motors, incomplete games, or zero advantage signal. After the two updates, audit the full loop, repeat the unchanged 36 real-serve and 64 short/deep probes, then eight development games at 1141000..1141007. Compare with the experimental initial actor and original parent. Keep final seeds unused.
scope: Bounded local self-play and older-opponent trial, not a full adaptive league. No runtime selector, controller changes, shaped rewards, final seeds, scene replacement, automatic promotion, or cloud compute. Pre-update self-play win rate is not evidence of improvement.
